title: Chronological-age transcriptomic directions are not portable scalar readouts of partial reprogramming
description: Single-author preprint and reproducibility release for a failure-preserving benchmark of chronological-age transcriptomic directions across partial-reprogramming studies. This work has not been peer reviewed.
notes: Preprint — not peer reviewed. Source code is Apache-2.0; manuscripts, protocols, figures and newly authored aggregate tables are CC BY 4.0. Third-party source data are excluded. Publication remains subject to the author's approval.
